title: Unused ERC20 tokens are not refunded, and can be stolen by attacker
It might not be possible to withdraw tokens from the basket
detail:
# Handle

Czar102


# Vulnerability details

## Impact
When enough basket token owners exit, it will be impossible to exit pool with the last `MIN_AMOUNT` tokens because of  check. This will result in locking some tokens forever.

## Recommended Mitigation Steps
Consider resigning from this check or performing it only for the owner balance, who would need to have at least `MIN_AMOUNT` tokens.
